headlines.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Stock Price Sinks As Q1 Results Fuel Profit Debate
headlines.summary: Sandisk just took a hit. The stock closed at US$1,150.89, down 13.47% today, even though fresh Q1 2027 results showed powerful profit momentum. Basic earnings per share came in at US$55.49 on quarterly revenue of US$11.03b, both well ahead of where this storage specialist was a year ago. Short-term traders see a sharp drop. Long-term investors see a memory manufacturer that has turned a recent loss into sizeable trailing 12 month earnings of US$132.12 per share.

headlines.title: Sandisk Sinks 13% Last Friday After a Beat: Kioxia Says the Flash Price Surge Is Fading
SanDisk CEO David Goeckeler Sees ‘Tremendous Pull’ as Customers Lock in Supply and Come Back for More — Pipeline Runs Through 2030
headlines.summary: SanDisk Corp.‘s customers are seeking long-term commitments for SanDisk’s memory supply, with one of its biggest buyers already back for a second round.

description: Sandisk Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices and solutions using NAND flash technology in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and internationally. The company provides solid state drives for desktop and notebook PCs, gaming consoles, and set top boxes; and flash-based embedded storage products for mobile phones, tablets, notebook PCs and other portable and wearable devices, automotive applications, Internet of Things, industrial, and connected home applications, as well as removable cards, universal serial bus drives, and wafers and components. It sells its products to computer manufacturers and original equipment manufacturers, datacenters, private cloud customers, cloud service providers, resellers, distributors, and retailers through its sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. Sandisk Corporation was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Milpitas, California.
